# Astro Siddhi (Sri Raghavendra Jyothishalayam)

> 25+ years veteran-led Vedic astrology and Vastu practice in MVP Colony, Visakhapatnam.
> Providing authentic horoscope readings, Telugu marriage Kundali matching, and non-demolition coastal Vastu guidance.

## About
Founded by Sri Raghavendra Siddhanti garu, Astro Siddhi delivers classical South Indian Vedic astrology consultations in Telugu and English. Over 15,000 clients served with a 4.9-star verified rating on Google.

- Career Astrology (https://www.astrosiddi.com/services/career-astrology): 10th house analysis for job transitions, promotion timing, and business ventures.
